The source mixes cumulative migration, founder and contemporaneous settlement counting scopes; these are retained and cannot be summed into one historical total.
Exact paths, dates, capacities, footprints and shares are reconstruction choices. No route has independent historical review.

A common logistic intrinsic rate is fitted to fund dated transfers from declared priors; this is a visualization calibration, not observed historical fertility. Regional capacities bound growth over5500 years.
CWC ancestry links are sister/precursor bookkeeping; dominant R1a and Beaker R1b-P312 are not literal paternal offspring of Yamnaya R1b-Z2103.
Anatolian contact prior is22500 local people with2500 incoming. Low/high local priors and other receptor counts are explicit independent display assumptions. South Asian local400000 is not a census.
Tarim_EMBA1/Xiaohe stays local ANE. Later MBA/LBA contacts are not proof of Tocharian language. BMAC cities stay local until later post1700 incorporation.
Mitanni elite inference is distinct from disputed Kassite/Wusun links; these proposals remain source context.
Alternative root, Anatolian, Celtic and Slavic hypotheses retain geometry and estimates, but are excluded from additive default animation.
BP in primary studies is normally before1950. Original rounded source labels are retained; broad calendar intervals follow supplied BCE/CE equivalents rather than manufacture exact years.
Modern land-mask geometry guides routes; intentional Baltic/North Sea/Channel/straits crossings are labelled mixed. Ancient coastlines, climate and exact terrain passes remain unreviewed.

Later post1000 Polish assimilation and later Tocharian/Wusun attestations remain context. Fragmentary Messapic, Venetic, Sicel and Lusitanian discussions are not manufactured into secure migration claims.

The source reuses TOC-1B for narrative Okunev replacement in Minusinsk and for table Dzungaria / Chemurchek / Tarim-edge integration. Both wordings are preserved; this is an unresolved source-code conflict, not an identity between those histories.

Habitat envelopes are explicit irregular river-terrace, foothill, pasture, coast and oasis reconstructions, weighted for resources and excluding declared unsuitable patches. They are not excavated settlement distributions or measured palaeoclimate models.
